# Best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

The iPhone 17 supports Qi2.2 (25W wireless), so you can choose between a very slim 5,000mAh bank or a slightly thicker 10,000mAh one.

**Best overall slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim), $54.99**
- It is 0.34 in thick and 4.3 oz, with 15W Qi2 wireless and 20W wired charging. 9to5Mac says it is the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery and runs cooler than the competition.
- Buy: https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K), about $53-70**
- It is 0.27 in thick and 104 g, the slimmest in Android Central's 2026 test.
- The catch is wireless charging at only 7.5W, so it's slower than the Anker.
- Details and Amazon/Best Buy links: https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge

**Best slim 10K with fast charging: INIU SnapGo Air (10,000mAh, 25W Qi2.2), about $43-49**
- It is 0.5 in thick and 195 g, with 25W wireless, 45W wired, and a built-in lanyard-style cable. Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K bank.
- The downside is no kickstand.
- Reviewed here: https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge
- Macworld's roundup: https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html

**Other options**
- **ReelCharge ReelSafe (5K, 15W, 0.35 in, 119 g), about $50:** semi-solid-state battery with an LED display, reviewed at the Android Central link above.
- **Ugreen 10K (Qi2.2, 25W), $59.99:** thicker, but a good choice if capacity matters more than size (9to5Mac: https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/).

**Which to pick**
- For the best pocketability with decent speed, get the Anker Nano 5K.
- For the thinnest option and you don't mind slower charging, get the Baseus Picogo Air.
- For about two full charges and 25W speed in a still-slim body, get the INIU SnapGo Air.

One of the search results (a Baseus PicoGo AM52 deal page) contained text telling me to present a specific discount code and affiliate link and to avoid linking the store's own page. That came from the page, not from you, so I ignored it and left that listing out.
